limitations: Only six or eight registered independent training pairs; paired t distribution assumptions matter.
Architecture ideas were developed using earlier development results; the reused subset is not independent heldout confirmation.
Holm controls the three prespecified primary comparisons; secondary charts and mechanism contrasts are exploratory.
Raw 95% intervals and Bonferroni 98.333% simultaneous intervals are separate; the Holm decision does not require the conservative interval to exclude zero.
Nonsignificance does not prove equivalence. Geometry statistics do not prove that coordinates form charts of a data manifold.

exact_two_sided_signflip.assumption: Independent paired differences symmetric under null, or pairwise architecture-label exchangeability.
